xmldoc.short_description: Convert a function to an optimization expression.

syntax.syntax_item: expr = fcn2optimexpr(fcn, in1, ..., inN, name, value)

param_input_item.param_description: function handle to convert into an optimization expression.
input arguments passed to fcn: optimization variables, optimization expressions, or numeric constants.

description.p: fcn2optimexpr converts a function into an optimization expression, so that functions that cannot be composed from the supported elementary operators can still be used as objectives or constraints in a problem-based model.
When the expression is evaluated, each input argument is evaluated for the current variable values, then fcn is called on the resulting numeric values.

xmldoc.bibliography: J. Nocedal and S. J. Wright, Numerical Optimization, Springer, 2006.

example_item.example_item_description: Wrap a scalar function of one variable.
Use a converted function as an objective.
